official: 立川市議会議員の報酬及び費用弁償等に関する条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会議案一覧

name: 議員の出張費用の種類を見直す
summary: 現在の条例では、議員の費用弁償の種類を鉄道賃、船賃、航空賃、車賃、旅行雑費、宿泊料と定めています。この議案では費用弁償の種類を改めます。改正後の費用区分は、令和8年4月1日以後に出発する出張に適用されます。
changes: 車賃をその他の交通費に改める
宿泊料を宿泊費、包括宿泊費、宿泊手当に分ける
旅行雑費を渡航雑費に改め、死亡手当を加える
why: 地方自治法第203条第4項の規定によるものと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Reviews the types of travel expenses for assembly members
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance Concerning Remuneration and Expense Reimbursement, etc. for Tachikawa City Assembly Members
en.summary: Under the current ordinance, the types of expense reimbursement for assembly members are railway fares, boat fares, airfares, vehicle fares, miscellaneous travel expenses, and accommodation expenses. This bill revises the types of expense reimbursement. The revised expense categories apply to business trips departing on or after April 1, 2026.
changes: Changes vehicle fares to other transportation expenses
Divides accommodation expenses into accommodation costs, inclusive accommodation costs, and an accommodation allowance
Renames miscellaneous travel expenses as miscellaneous overseas travel expenses and adds a death allowance
en.why: The city explains that this is based on Article 203, Paragraph 4 of the Local Autonomy Act.
